page.overview:
Who is Tabitha Bing?

Red (Graphic Novel)|first_appearance=Hide-and-Seek|eye_color=Brown (Graphic Novel)|color=Light|aliases=Tab|occupation=High School Student}} Tabitha Bing is a major character in Hide-and-Seek, the third story from Fazbear Frights 6: Blackbird.

She's a school outcast who takes notice of Toby’s poor health and attempts to help him. Tabitha has black hair and a freckled face. She usually wears makeup and has a nose piercing. Tabitha also wears a lot of black.

Tabitha is somewhat of an outcast that likes to rebel against the system, occasionally starting petitions to get things changed around school. She is also very friendly and supportive, doing everything to help those she thinks need it.

Because of her caring nature, Toby thinks she blows little things out of proportion.
